SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE

CRUD maps to creating, reading, updating and deleting records. SQL uses INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE and
DELETE.
CRUD කියන්Jන් records create, read, update සහ delete කිරීමයි. UPDATE සහ DELETE වල WHERE එක
Manage customers through an admin dashboard.
INSERT: create → SELECT: read → UPDATE: change → DELETE: remove
Follow the arrows to see how the related objects or operations connect.
Diagram එJක් boxes සහ arrows අනුව සම්බන්ධතාවය Jහහෝ පියවරෙ මාලාව බලන්න.
Expected result: One row is added, read, changed and removed.

Interview question: What if UPDATE has no WHERE?
Answer: All rows may be updated.
